0022600007.text: The Denver Nuggets open their 2026-27 season on the road against the Oklahoma City Thunder, who are 1-0 and sit first in the Northwest Division and the West. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-3 in Oklahoma City's favor, though Denver won the most recent meeting 127-107 in Denver on April 10, 2026, and no games have been played yet in this season's series. Denver will be without Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain) and will have Spencer Jones as a game-time decision (day-to-day, hamstring), while Oklahoma City is missing Nikola Topic (out, back surgery), Otega Oweh (out, Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee surgery).
